meta.title: Product categories and sourcing
meta.description: Browse the twelve product categories the company is registered to trade in, and send an inquiry to source products from China.

index.title: Product categories for sourcing and trade
index.description: Twelve areas of trade taken from the company's registered business scope. Products are sourced against buyer requirements, so a specific need starts with an inquiry.

categories.description: Open a category to see the registered scope behind it and any products that have been published.
